# Windhawk add-ons

Unmodified upstream sources retrieved 2026-11-12:

- [Resource Redirect 1.3](https://github.com/ramensoftware/windhawk-mods/blob/main/mods/icon-resource-redirect.wh.cpp), m417z, GPL-3.0 (license notice in source).
- [Lock Screen Clock Styler 0.6.0](https://github.com/ramensoftware/windhawk-mods/blob/main/mods/lock-screen-clock-styler.wh.cpp), ali0zdas, MIT (license notice in source).

Build with `Build-Theme-Addons.ps1`. Resource Redirect is restricted to Explorer, with experimental all-resource redirection off. Windows resource files are not replaced; the theme contains only selected icon resources. Lock screen changes take effect on the next LockApp start. Runtime verification is separate from compilation.
